text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
...Gh, haa...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, look!
That bulletin board!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
My number! It's on there!
Look, look!! Check it out!!

Tosen Jordan pointed at the results board
and hopped up and down repeatedly.

On the grand stage of a GⅠ,
she delivered undeniable results.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Totally nailed it, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Tosen Jordan-san!
We have a scrum interview we'd love for you
to participate in, if you have a moment..."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh, me!? An interview for me!?
choice_data_list: This is the first step to making it big.
This is the first step to making it big, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...He-Heheh!
Just watch me~! I'll give a great comment!
After boasting so boldly, Tosen Jordan headed to the venue, but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...This is bad...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Next, we have a question for Tosen Jordan-san.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hyai!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Taking this race into account, what are your prospects for the next one?
Given her aptitudes, we assume you're targeting medium-to-long distances, but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uhh... what's up?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
choice_data_list: I'm asking what our next goal is...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ! Ah, gotcha. Okay, okay.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the Triple Crown. I'm aiming for the Triple Crown!
'Cause I'm gonna hit it big!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: The Satsuki Sho, and the Japan Derby, and the Shuka Sho!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
!? Th-The Kikuka Sho!
The Satsuki Sho, the Derby, and the Kikuka Sho!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
What that girl said just now...
do you think she was serious...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
"No, you can't be serious.
Who gets the names of the Classic Triple Crown wrong?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text:
She was fiddling with her nails the whole press conference, not listening to a single question...
She's a lost cause, that one.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: …Even though you're so serious about chasing your dream…
...Even though you're aiming for it with all your heart.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine. Don't worry about that.
Seriously, it's no big deal."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Once I actually win the Triple Crown races,
those people will finally get it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Mm. I'm gonna go get changed.

Yet as Tosen Jordan headed back to the waiting room,
her shoulders were visibly slumped.
choice_data_list: (...First, let's prove them wrong at the Satsuki Sho.)

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
That girl, just now...
...Were those tears...?

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah, excuse me! Are you Tosen Jordan-san's
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's awesome! Please let me watch her training next time!

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I grew interested after seeing her run today
and watching her press conference just now. It's been a long time since I've seen eyes burning with such fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
So... you're serious about this, right?
About aiming for the Triple Crown.

As long as she keeps running straight ahead,
the number of people watching her
is sure to grow, little by little.
First—starting with the Satsuki Sho.
